Sysvar rent account encode, update, and read helpers.

# Purpose
`fd_sysvar_rent.c` implements the `rent` sysvar access logic for the bank and transaction state. It provides a write path in [`fd_sysvar_rent_write`](<#fd_sysvar_rent_write>) that encodes an `fd_rent_t` value into a fixed-size buffer and stores it in the sysvar account by calling `fd_sysvar_account_update`. The [`fd_sysvar_rent_init`](<#fd_sysvar_rent_init>) function reads the current rent parameters from the bank with `fd_bank_rent_query` and writes them into the sysvar account during initialization.

The file also provides a read path in [`fd_sysvar_rent_read`](<#fd_sysvar_rent_read>), which loads the `rent` sysvar account from `fd_funk_t`, checks that the account exists and has nonzero lamports, and then decodes the account data into an `fd_rent_t` object with `fd_bincode_decode_spad`. The code uses `fd_txn_account_init_from_funk_readonly` for account lookup and returns `NULL` when the sysvar account is not present or is treated as absent by the lamport check.
